summary: App for bike, motorcycle, and supercar enthusiasts.

existing_features.title: Create an MVP app for bike, motorcycle, and supercar enthusiasts with a public browsing experience that lets users explore curated vehicles by category (Bikes, Motorcycles, Supercars) and view a vehicle detail page with images and specs (e.g., brand, model, year, engine/power, top speed, 0–60, weight).
Add Internet Identity sign-in to unlock personalization features: authenticated users can favorite/unfavorite vehicles and see a dedicated Favorites page listing their saved vehicles.
Build the frontend IA (information architecture) and navigation: Home, Category Browse (Bikes/Motorcycles/Supercars), Vehicle Detail, Favorites, and an About page describing the app for enthusiasts.

Establish a creative, coherent visual theme suitable for a high-performance vehicle enthusiast app (non-blue/non-purple primary palette), including typography, spacing, card styles, and a consistent component style across all pages.
Add generated static brand assets (logo and a hero/banner image) and render them from frontend static assets (not served through the backend).
Create a new frontend page that provides a simple “Add Vehicle” form to insert vehicles into the catalog (Bike, Motorcycle, Car) by calling the backend create/add method.
Add an optional “Seed sample vehicles” action in the UI that inserts a small curated starter set across Bike, Motorcycle, and Car categories for quick testing.
Ensure React Query vehicle lists refresh appropriately after adding or seeding vehicles so users immediately see newly inserted items on Home/Category pages.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an app for bikes, motorcycles, and supercars lovers (enthusiast-focused app).

Implement backend persistence in the single Motoko main actor for: (1) the vehicle catalog and (2) per-user favorites. Provide query/update methods needed by the frontend to list categories, list vehicles by category, fetch a vehicle by id, and manage favorites.
Provide a way to add/insert vehicles (bikes, motorcycles, supercars) into the catalog (e.g., seed data workflow and/or admin/add-vehicle method/UI).

Add a backend update method that allows creating a new vehicle with an automatically assigned unique ID (so users do not need to manually choose the `id` when inserting bikes, motorcycles, or supercars).

projectName: Vehicle Enthusiast Hub for Bikes, Motorcycles, and Supercars
